layers.@comment: The player stands on its feet as the villager and the zombie do: while it stands still (see onFeet), and in the sword's stance, its feet wider apart, core:step_turn plants them in the world and turns the body only as far as they have stepped. It walks, runs and does the rest by its clips, the driver off; it comes back on at once when the player stands, each foot planted where the legs are drawn (placeFromPose), a foot further than finishDrift from its place stepping back under the body; it goes off over two ticks as the player sets off, and at once otherwise (an attack, the sneak, a bow), whatever comes next smoothing the legs and the whole model from where the driver drew them. RenderPlayer draws the model at 0.9375 of its size, so a block is 16 / 0.9375 model units. The head keeps looking where the player looks.
